thread:
alex: Quick ask — can someone run A100 vs H100 vs L40S latency/throughput microbenchmarks for text-gen (model: llama2-70b, seq_len 4096, sampling disabled) across batch sizes [1,4,8,16]? Suspect a regression after commit d2f4a1b that touched kernel selection. Need p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec. Would prefer runs on Dedicated hosts (no autoscale).

maya: I can kick off A100 + H100 runs tonight. Which runtime image & quantization should I use? We have two variants in staging: `runtime:latest` (torch 2.1 + triton) and `runtime:opt-2025-02` (our kernel selection heuristics). Also: do you want fp16 vs q4f16?

alex: Use `runtime:opt-2025-02` and q4f16 so we compare quantized execution. Keep deterministic sampling off and max_new_tokens=1024. Important: capture tail latency (p99) and 99.9 if possible. Please log raw output to s3 and upload CSV of summary.

maya: Ack. I'll use this command (adapted from bench-cli):
```
./bench --model llama2-70b-q4f16 \  --backend triton \  --seq-len 4096 \  --max-new-tokens 1024 \  --batch-sizes 1,4,8,16 \  --warmup 10 --iters 120 \  --output s3://redwood-perf/bench/1743204567/maya/
```
I'll tag results with commit `d2f4a1b`.

sjohnson: FYI I ran a quick L40S smoke run on `runtime:opt-2025-02` earlier today (single sample): batch=1 => p50 ~ 45ms, p99 ~ 200ms, throughput ~= 95 tok/s (max_new_tokens=512). That was with q4f16 on a single L40S. Could be worth rerunning full matrix.

raul: heads-up — Dedicated L40S pool has slightly different nvlink config (driver 535.86) vs our A100 hosts (driver 530.x). Might impact collectives or kernel fallback. Put driver and cuda versions in the metadata for each run.

alex: Good catch. Add `uname -a`, `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,cuda_version,name --format=csv` and `pip freeze | grep torch` to the run artifacts.

benchbot: Scheduled perf job for H100 on host h100-ded-12 starting 2025-03-14T02:30Z. Job id: perf-17432-01. Will upload logs to s3://redwood-perf/bench/1743204567/benchbot/h100/.

maya: Running A100 now. ETA ~2.5h for full matrix. I'll push a CSV summary like: `gpu,backend,commit,batch,seq,p50,p95,p99,tokens_per_sec,driver,cuda,torch_version` and a small JSON with raw p99 distribution.

sjohnson: If anyone hits p99 spikes, enable `--profile-kernel` on the bench CLI so we can see which kernel paths are hot. Last time we saw p99 linked to a fallback to a slower attention kernel for certain sequence lengths.

raul: Also include config for `kernel_selection: dynamic` vs `static` in metadata. We need to know if heuristics chose a fallback.

alex: Thanks. I'll collate everything into PERF-789 and update the spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PerfSheetExample (please paste CSV links in the sheet). Assigning: maya -> A100/H100 runs, sjohnson -> L40S full matrix, raul -> infra/drivers check. Please aim for EOD PST so we can triage tomorrow. :eyes:

maya: Roger. Will post s3 links and short summary when done. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder: Dedicated pool `l40s-prod` has maintenance window 2025-03-15 04:00-04:30 UTC; avoid scheduling long jobs then.

alex: Noted — thanks infra-bot.

sjohnson: I'll start L40S runs in ~30m and include `--profile-kernel`. If anyone needs me to run a different quant or seq_len, ping here.
